name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source customer feedback and support platform with feedback boards, roadmap, changelog, support inbox, help center and status page, backed by PostgreSQL and S3 storage.

alerts.message: The first account created owns the setup and nobody else can sign up until it is finished, so create yours right after deployment. Without email configured, sign-in codes and emails are written to the app logs; set the EMAIL_SMTP_* variables to send real mail.
